factor_specs.economic_rationale: Bali-Cakici-Whitelaw 2011: Investors with lottery preference systematically overpay for stocks with recent extreme positive returns. High MAX(t) predicts negative 1M ahead return. KR retail share >50% predicts strong lottery preference. Direction in registry: lower_better. After IC-based alignment, high Z_aligned = low MAX = high expected alpha. NOTE: KR result diverges from Bali 2011 US 1962-2005 defensive characterization — KR M22 is risk-on/elevated-regime factor (see AX-001 v2 reinterpretation).
references: Bali, T. G., Cakici, N., & Whitelaw, R. F. (2011). Maxing out: Stocks as lotteries and the cross-section of expected returns. Journal of Financial Economics, 99(2), 427-446.
